SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7857

Section 1, Special Br. Station,
REPORT
Date April 7, 1937.

Subject Letter, dated 18th March 1937, addressed to H.B.M. Consulate by a person who signs himself "Anonymous. Family Man" complaining of the seduction of his wife by Margaret Kennedy.

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

With reference to the anonymous letter, dated 18th March, from a "family man," addressed to H.B.M. Consul-General, alleging the seduction of his wife: the woman named therein, Mrs. Margaret Kennedy, alias Mrs. M.O. King, American citizen, resides at 1321 Rue Lafayette under the name of King and conducts a brothel of the "superior" type at 473, Kiangse Road, under the name of Kennedy, by which name she is more familiarly known. Her present establishment in Kiangse Road was opened on 29th December 1932, prior to which date she conducted a similar place at 14 Soochow Road.

A.V. Beaumont, former Editor of the "Shanghai Spectator," with the supposed intention of blackmailing Mrs. Kennedy, published in his paper several articles in which she was alleged to have established addresses in the Settlement for the reception of foreign married women of the potential harlot type. Notwithstanding the reprehensible disposition of the author it was generally considered, at the time, that there may have been some justification for his accusations.

Mrs. Kennedy was interviewed confidentially regarding the contents of the letter and strongly denied that she had had any hand in the seduction of any married women. She stated that she kept very much to her own company and that of the girls in her establishment who sometimes visited her, and of whom eight are at present employed in the Kiangse Road place. None of these girls, to her knowledge, is married, and whilst some of them have private addresses apart from the rooms they occupy at 473, Kiangse Road, she is quite familiar with their habits and mode of life when free of the obligations attendant upon their calling and she could, therefore, say with convict-

（左侧手写批注：File pending any further developments）
（左侧印章：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER SHANGHAI 8 APR.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7857

特务科第一分署，
报告
日期：1937年4月7日。

事由：关于一封日期为1937年3月18日、署名“匿名者。有家室之人”致英国驻华领事馆的信件，信中投诉 Margaret Kennedy 引诱其妻子。

由警督 Laurier 呈报，经警督 J. Boyne 转递

关于那封日期为3月18日、来自一位“有家室之人”并致英国总领事的匿名信，信中指控其妻子被引诱：信中提及的女子 Margaret Kennedy 夫人，又名 M.O. King 夫人，系美国公民，以 King 为名居住于拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1321号，并以 Kennedy 为名在江西路473号经营一家“高级”妓院，她更为人所知的名字是 Kennedy。她在江西路的这家场所开业于1932年12月29日，在此日期之前，她在苏州路14号经营类似的场所。

《上海观察家报》（Shanghai Spectator）前编辑 A.V. Beaumont 出于敲诈 Kennedy 夫人的所谓意图，在其报纸上发表了几篇文章，指控她在租界内设立地址，接待具有潜在妓女性质的外国已婚妇女。尽管该作者的居心可鄙，但当时人们普遍认为，他的指控可能有一定的依据。

就信件内容对 Kennedy 夫人进行了秘密约谈，她强烈否认自己曾参与引诱任何已婚妇女。她表示，她主要只与自己以及她场所中的女孩们交往，这些女孩有时会来拜访她，目前有八人在江西路的场所受雇。据她所知，这些女孩中无人已婚，虽然她们当中有些人在江西路473号的房间之外另有私人住址，但她非常熟悉她们在摆脱职业义务后的习惯和生活方式，因此她可以确信地断言——

（左侧手写批注：待有进一步进展再归档）
（左侧印章：上海总监办公室 4月8日）
（左下角手写签名/缩写：JMR 8/4）

March 17, 1937
18 MAR 1937

The Honorable British Consulate,
Shanghai, China.

Gentlemen:-

Just a small letter to ask of you gentlemen
if you would help me in a personal matter. There is a
foreign lady Mrs. M. O. King that is either a British or
American subject that resides at 1321 Rue Lafayette. My
wife has been keeping quite a friendly and intimate
companionship with this woman most every night until quite
late hours. I've asked her a number of times what was so
attractive with her and I get no satisfaction from her other
than, just friends. Through personal observation I find that
a number to times parties were held there and then they would
all leave in motor cars. After somemore noticing I have
found they go to a House at 473 Kiangse. As far as I can find
out a woman whose name is M. Kennedy owns this house and is
the same Mrs. King as on Rue Lafayette. What takes place in
that house with my wife I cannot tell as I'm not a patron of
such places nor do I wish to have my wife find that I'm what
you may call, eaves dropper.
Now I ask you gentlemen to see if you can help
me break up such doings at that House and by doing that I'm
positive it will bring my home to a more quiet and settled
conditions.

Sincerely yours

Anonymous.
Family man.

（批：Si
Is this a "Salon of Love"
referred to m r Russian Pass ?）

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH
19 MAR. 1937
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

1937年3月17日
1937年3月18日

尊敬的英国领事馆，
中国上海。

先生们：

谨以此短函恳请诸位先生在一件私事上予以帮助。有一位外籍女士 M. O. King 夫人，她是英国或美国籍人士，居住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1321号。我的妻子几乎每晚都与这位女士保持相当友好和亲密的伙伴关系，直到很晚。我曾多次问她这位女士有什么如此吸引人的地方，但她除了说是“只是朋友”外，并未给我满意的答复。通过个人观察，我发现那里经常举行聚会，然后众人便乘汽车离开。经过进一步的留意，我发现他们前往江西路473号的一处住宅。据我所知，拥有一处名为 M. Kennedy 的女子的房子，她与拉斐特路上的 King 夫人是同一个人。我无法告知在我妻子在那所房子里发生了什么，因为我不是那种地方的常客，也不希望我的妻子发现我在做什么，你们可能会称之为偷听者。
现在，我请求诸位先生看看能否帮助我取缔那所房子里的这种行径，我相信这样做将使我的家庭恢复到更加安静和稳定的状态。

此致

敬礼

匿名者。
有家室之人。

（批注：Si
这是否是俄罗斯护照案中提到的“爱情沙龙”？）

（印章：特务科
1937年3月19日
上海公共租界工部局警务处）
